text: BAM share fell 0.11 percentage points over the last 22 hours to 34.4%, while the 7-day change is up 0.26 percentage points. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 21.8% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 70 top-node leadership changes in the window are whale-driven routing, not evidence of a structural rollover; the only validated structural rollover remains the fra event with 22 minutes of warning.
